worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.summary: Raise Defense and break free of restraints. Leave a poisonous acid pool or use the mobile form. This Defense increase ends when the liquid form expires.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.use.0: Liquefy to slip out of a bind or a pin
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.use.1: Spread a corrosive puddle under the opponent
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.use.2: Ride out a round of close-range hits as a slicker liquid
While liquid, Defense is raised by %1$s level(s) for about %2$s; the boost is taken back when the liquid ends and you re-form.
The liquid form immediately breaks free of entangling and pinning effects and moves faster while it lasts.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.acid.on: Acid pool: leaves a puddle %1$s blocks in radius at your feet for about %2$s; opponents who step in are poisoned and are poisoned again while they stay, losing health over time.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.acid.off: Slick body: no puddle, in exchange for a longer liquid window and a faster glide - trading field control for stronger self-preservation.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.growth.0: At level %1$s the liquid lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.growth.1: At level %1$s the liquid lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.preference.s: On: no acid pool, in exchange for a longer liquid window and a faster glide. Off: leave a pool that poisons opponents who step in, at the cost of a liquid window multiplied by 0.8.
worldcombat.skill.acidarmor.preference.a: The companion considers melting only when a threat is within this distance; larger means earlier preparation.
Below this health ratio the companion melts ahead of the shared order; higher enters the liquid stance earlier, lower only when nearly down.
Casting it again while still liquid stacks more Defense and refreshes the liquid's duration, up to the stat-stage cap, all taken back when you re-form.
